title: Recidivism
pdf_title: ## CHAPTER 9 ## RECIDIVISM The information on ‘Recidivism’ was available in respect of 20,48,792 offenders during the year 1983 out of which 19,34,377 i.e. 94.4 per cent were new offenders. Of these the percentage of persons who were arrested in the past once, twice and thrice or more was 4.1 per cent, 1.0 per cent and 0.5 per cent respectively. It was found that 13.0 per cent of the persons arrested for the offence of Burglaries were convicted in the past and this accounted for the highest percentage of ‘Recidivism’ closely followed by ‘Thefts’ (12.9%), ‘Dacoity’ (11.9%), and ‘Robbery’ (10.1%). The relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of ‘Recidivism’ are presented in Table 53 and 54.
